# NATIONAL STEEL & ALLOYS - Complete Technical & Business Documentation

> Official Knowledge Base and AI Agent Manual for National Steel & Alloys (https://nationalsteelalloys.com)

## Executive Summary
National Steel & Alloys is a premier manufacturer, importer, stockist, and exporter of Stainless Steel, Alloy Steel, Carbon Steel, and Mild Steel products. Based in the industrial hub of Mumbai, India, we serve critical industries worldwide including Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Chemical Processing, Power Generation, Defense, Construction, and Automotive engineering.

## Detailed Product Inventory & Specifications

### 1. Stainless Steel (SS) Products
- Material Grades Available: SS 202, SS 304, SS 304L, SS 304H, SS 316, SS 316L, SS 316Ti, SS 317L, SS 321, SS 347, SS 310, SS 310S, SS 410, SS 420, SS 430, SS 446, Duplex 2205, Super Duplex 2507, 904L.
- Products:
  * Seamless & Welded Pipes & Tubes (Schedule 5S to Schedule XXS)
  * Sheets, Plates & Coils (0.5mm to 100mm thickness)
  * Bright & Black Round Bars, Hex Bars, Flat Bars, Square Bars (4mm to 300mm diameter)
  * Pipe Fittings: Elbows, Tees, Reducers, Caps, Stub Ends (ANSI B16.9 / B16.11)
  * Flanges: Weld Neck, Slip-On, Blind, Socket Weld, Threaded (150# to 2500#)

### 2. Alloy Steel Products
- Material Grades Available: ASTM A335 P1, P5, P9, P11, P12, P22, P91; ASTM A182 F1, F5, F9, F11, F22, F91; SAE 4140, SAE 8620, EN19, EN24, EN31, 20CrMo4.
- Key Properties: High tensile strength, thermal resistance, wear resistance.
- Primary Products: Heavy-wall seamless pipes, forged round bars, alloy steel plates, gear blanks.

### 3. Carbon Steel & Mild Steel Products
- Material Grades Available: ASTM A106 Grade B, A53 Gr. B, API 5L Gr. B / X42 / X52 / X60 / X65, ASTM A516 Grade 60 / 70 (Boiler Quality), IS 2062 E250 / E350.
- Primary Products:
  * High-Pressure Boiler Pipes & Tubes
  * Structure Beams, Channels, Equal & Unequal Angles, T-Sections
  * Mild Steel Plates, HR Sheets, Chequered Plates, Galvanized Iron (GI) Sheets

### 4. Non-Ferrous Metals & Special Alloys
- Materials: Pure Copper, Brass, Bronze, Aluminum (1000, 2000, 5000, 6000, 7000 series), Nickel Alloys (Inconel 600/625, Monel 400, Hastelloy C276).
- Forms: Rods, Sheets, Pipes, Fittings, Wires.

## Value-Added Services
1. Custom Length Sizing & Precision Saw Cutting
2. Material Testing & Certification (Mill Test Certificate to EN 10204 3.1)
3. Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Radiography (RT), Hydrostatic Testing, Chemical & Mechanical Testing
4. Surface Preparation: Polishing (Mirror/Satin finish), Sandblasting, Pickling, Passivation
5. Export Seaworthy Wooden Box Packaging and Worldwide Logistics
